records.command: $dipAudit = (& "$env:APPDATA\npm\dip.cmd" reconcile | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json); $dipAudit.tasks | Where-Object { $_.title -match '^DIP-[LB]|^Design scalable|^Evaluate Laya|^Compare open-source' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{id=$_.id;title=$_.title;status=$_.status;priority=$_.priority;description=$_.description;acceptance=$_.acceptance;checkpoint=($_.checkpoints | Where-Object { -not $_.automatic } | Select-Object -Last 1);documents=$_.documents;verification=$_.verification;integrated=$_.integrated} } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10; $dipAudit.tasks | Group-Object status | Select-Object Name,Count | ConvertTo-Json; $dipAudit.tasks | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'task_946d6e12859ad5986645e9e0127add5a352aafb520417424c484f72982cd24be' } | Select-Object id,status,verification,integrated | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; $dipAudit.errors | ConvertTo-Json
